meta.title: QeydAI — AI sales and enrollment assistant for learning centers
meta.description: Answer WhatsApp, Instagram and Telegram inquiries automatically, book trial lessons and stop losing leads.

hero.title: Turn every inquiry into an enrollment
hero.subtitle: The parent writing at midnight and the student writing at noon both get an instant reply. QeydAI books the trial lesson, and your team talks only to ready buyers.

features.title: Removes every step that slows a sale

ai.title: Natural Azerbaijani
ai.body: Understands typos and everyday speech. States only the prices and schedules you have approved.

inbox.title: One unified inbox
inbox.body: Start with Telegram, then bring WhatsApp and Instagram into the same panel.

enroll.title: Smart enrollment
enroll.body: Offers only real trial lessons. Refuses full groups and repeat sign-ups.

crm.title: Simple CRM and reports
crm.body: How many inquiries came in, how many enrolled, how many paid, at a glance.

human.title: Human handoff
human.body: When the AI is unsure, it passes the question to a manager. It never makes things up.

tenant.title: Each center keeps its own data
tenant.body: Courses, customers and reports are fully separated between centers.

one.title: Add your courses
one.body: Enter prices, schedules and trial lesson dates once.

two.title: Connect a channel
two.body: The Telegram bot works right away; WhatsApp and Instagram follow after official approval.

three.title: Watch enrollments arrive
three.body: Managers are notified the moment someone signs up.

pricing.title: Simple, open pricing
pricing.note: This is an initial offer, finalized together with pilot centers.

setup.label: Setup
setup.body: One time: courses, schedule and channel connection.

contact.title: Let us test it at your center
contact.subtitle: Leave your phone number and we will contact you within 24 hours.
contact.name: Your name
contact.privacy: Your details are used only to contact you.
contact.ok: Thank you! We will be in touch soon.
contact.error: Could not send. Check the number and try again.

footer.tagline: AI sales assistant for Azerbaijani learning centers.

demo.title: Live chat example
demo.u1: Hi, do you have an IELTS course? how much
demo.b1: Hello! Yes. IELTS is 180 AZN per month, 3 lessons a week. Would you like to book a trial lesson?
demo.b2: The Saturday 11:00 trial lesson has 2 seats left. Please send your name and phone number.
